title: How to Use 3 Fuses in Project P.I.T.T. — Fuse Box & UP?
description: Insert all three fuses into the upper/catwalk Fuse Box (right-side/elevated area); completing the fuse progression leads into the next 200kg step and puzzle chain.
h1: How to Use 3 Fuses in Project P.I.T.T. — Fuse Box & UP?
quickAnswer: You must find and insert three fuses into the Fuse Box located in the facility’s upper/catwalk (right-side/elevated) area; placing all three completes the Fuse progression, advances into the 200kg step, and is linked by community reports to the UP? achievement.

facts.label: Fuses required
facts.value: The Fuse Box requires three fuses; all three must be placed to complete the Fuse progression.

facts.label: Fuse Box location
facts.value: Community descriptions place the Fuse Box in an upper/catwalk area on the facility’s right-side or otherwise elevated portion; this is a landmark-level location, not an exact coordinate.

facts.label: Progression result
facts.value: Placing all three fuses completes the Fuse progression and leads directly into the 200kg scale/weight-puzzle progression.

facts.label: UP? achievement
facts.value: UP? is a Steam achievement listed publicly; full-release community indexes and reports consistently connect UP? with completing the Fuse step, though that connection is community-identified rather than a Steam-official description.
